stories.headline: Japan launched a mission to bring home dust from a Mars moon
stories.summary: JAXA's MMX lifted off on an H3 rocket and is now heading for Mars, arriving in August 2027. It plans 2 landings on the moon Phobos and a capsule landing in Australia in 2031.
stories.why: The sample could finally show how Mars got its 2 potato-shaped moons.

stories.headline: Copying a 700-year-old mural revealed the Buddha's head was off
stories.summary: Chinese artists spent 3 years copying the Met's 50-foot Medicine Buddha mural crack by crack. They found museum mounters had placed the Buddha's head 2 cm out of line.
stories.why: The life-size replica made its debut at a museum in Beijing.

stories.headline: An endangered Australian fish was bred in captivity for the 1st time
stories.summary: Scientists in New South Wales bred the threatened Australian grayling in a hatchery, with fertility over 85%. The fish was hit hard by drought, the 2019-20 bushfires and floods.
stories.why: Hatchery-bred fish could now help refill rivers in the wild.

stories.headline: Mozambique protected its 'butterfly forest' on Mount Mabu
stories.summary: A government decree set aside 23,000 acres of Mount Mabu as a community conservation area. Its rainforest holds over 200 butterfly species and creatures found nowhere else.
stories.why: Local people already treat the mountain as sacred, and will help manage it.

fun_fact: Phobos is only about 22 km wide and circles Mars 3 times a day.
